description: Golden cases for .claude/skills/test-strategy (Frappe edition). Each case names a change to spice_lite; the plan must cover the listed categories, reference the real existing tests by TestClass#test_method, and surface the listed risks. facts[] records what reading (read:) or running under bench run-tests (run:) showed, so a grader can check a plan by hand.
matching: requiredCategories: at least one test case per category. mustReferenceTests: exact TestClass#test_method strings that must appear. mustMention: each term (or one of a list of alternatives), case-insensitive. minCases / minFindings: row counts.

facts: run: 1, 5, 20 subjects issue 2, 10, 40 queries (Postgres, caches warm)
run: code=http://loinc.org|8480-6 returns total 0
run: an amended Observation without effective_datetime loses to the final it replaces
run: a newer preliminary Observation with no value is returned with valueQuantity.value 0.0 (D-1)
run: FrappeTestCase.assertQueryCount raises TypeError on Postgres (LazyDecode), passes on MariaDB
read: duplicates are removed by parse_subjects (mappers.py:129), unlike the Java edition
read: existing lastn tests are test_lastn_returns_latest_per_patient, test_lastn_requires_subjects, test_lastn_query_count_grows_with_subjects
read: fhir.py:95 methods=["POST"]; 201 on success (fhir.py:136)
read: fhir.py:130-133 ValidationError -> rollback to savepoint, 422 invalid
read: fhir.py:127-129 PermissionError on insert -> 403
read: value: float | None is coerced by pydantic in tests ("72" -> 72.0), see test_create_observation_as_clinician
read: no API test for an encounter of another patient, for an amendment, or for GET being refused
read: existing tests test_create_observation_as_clinician, test_create_final_observation_without_unit_is_422, test_user_without_clinician_role_is_forbidden
read: fhir.py:34 MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS = 50 and fhir.py:88 limit_page_length; no test reaches 51 matches
read: mappers.py:109-113 parse_token drops the system, so identifier=urn:other|X searches MRN X
read: fhir.py:69-72 rejects %, _ and backslash (D-5, test_search_rejects_like_wildcards)
run: one search_patients call issues 5 queries (Postgres, caches warm)
read: fhir.py:91 audit logs names and a count, never family or identifier
read: patches.txt lists it under [post_model_sync]
read: backfill_patient_country.py:16-18 returns early when spice_lite_country_code is not set
read: backfill_patient_country.py:29-34 uses frappe.qb.update (bypasses permissions, fine in a patch)
read: test_fhir_api.py test_backfill_country_patch runs it twice (idempotent) and checks an untouched patient
ADR-0002: Custom Field national_health_id (unique, search_index) shipped by the integration app spice_nhid; search_patients dispatches identifier tokens by system; verification runs in frappe.enqueue
read: run-tests does not migrate, so the Custom Field must be created in the test (or by the app install) before searching
read: frappe.enqueue(now=True) runs the job body directly, the deterministic way to test it
read: existing test_search_by_identifier_token must keep passing

cases.input: Bug SL-133: lastn returns a newer preliminary Observation whose missing value reads as 0.0. Plan the tests for the fix.
facts: run: preliminary Observation with no value is stored as 0.0 (D-1) and wins lastn
read: testing-standards.md: every bug fix starts with a failing test named after the defect id
read: TestSLObservation#test_missing_value_is_stored_as_zero_known_defect pins D-1 and must keep passing until D-1 is fixed
